yazdegerd_agenda_634.title: The court records
yazdegerd_agenda_634.intro: Review the present records, then leave a later review open or set it aside.

stages.name: Present records
stages.text: Record attention without a public transaction.

choices.label: Retain the records
choices.detail: Spend nothing and leave the later review open.

stages.name: Later records
stages.text: Review the arrangements that actually remain at the adulthood boundary.

choices.label: Retain present arrangements
choices.detail: Complete the records without a public transaction or reward.
